title: HubSpot Import Results
description: Output from the HubSpot company data import operation

totalCompanies.title: Total Companies
totalCompanies.description: Total number of companies in the input mapping

skippedCount.title: Skipped Count
skippedCount.description: Number of companies skipped (e.g. missing URL)

failureCount.title: Failure Count
failureCount.description: Number of companies that failed to import

unmatchedCompanies.title: Unmatched Companies
unmatchedCompanies.description: URLs of companies that had no matching dataset item

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: The Apify dataset ID that was imported from

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the import started

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the import finished
